# Mokosh, Collapse Storm, Yellow Zone, Doll, Frame.

(A shadow is abruptly cast over the desert.)
column2: (Sebuah bayangan mendadak jatuh menutupi gurun.)

column1: (Above the constantly swirling Collapse storm, this shadow is moving at an extremely fast speed, attempting to cover the base vehicle driving at full speed within the storm.)
column2: (Di atas Collapse Storm yang terus berpusar, bayangan itu bergerak dengan kecepatan luar biasa, berusaha menaungi kendaraan markas yang melaju kencang di dalam badai.)

column1: (Fortunately, this Yellow Zone has always been sparsely populated, otherwise if someone looked up now, they would definitely find what they saw unbelievable—perhaps even rubbing their eyes hard in disbelief.)
column2: (Untungnya Yellow Zone ini memang selalu jarang penduduk, kalau tidak, siapa pun yang mendongak sekarang pasti tak akan percaya pada apa yang dilihatnya—mungkin sampai mengucek matanya keras-keras.)

column1: (Because at this moment, what is floating between the desert and the sun is not a cloud, but...)
column2: (Sebab saat ini, yang melayang di antara gurun dan matahari bukanlah awan, melainkan...)

column1: (A 'giant dragon'.)
column2: (Seekor 'naga raksasa'.)

column1: (The girl sat astride the scarred giant dragon, her light-colored eyes slightly lowered.)
column2: (Gadis itu duduk di punggung naga raksasa yang penuh luka, matanya yang berwarna terang sedikit menunduk.)

column1: (If someone could see it now, they might think these eyes were admiring a flowing work of art, or gazing at a long-lost lover—but they would never imagine that she was locking onto targets on the ground with extremely superior dynamic vision.)
column2: (Kalau ada yang bisa melihatnya sekarang, mereka mungkin mengira mata itu sedang mengagumi karya seni yang mengalir, atau menatap kekasih yang lama hilang—tapi mereka tak akan pernah membayangkan dia sedang mengunci sasaran di darat dengan penglihatan dinamis yang jauh di atas rata-rata.)

column1: (In the high-altitude view, The Elmo looked like just an insignificant little black dot in the golden sand waves.)
column2: (Dari ketinggian, Elmo tampak hanya seperti titik hitam kecil tak berarti di tengah gelombang pasir keemasan.)

column1: Lower.
column2: Turun.

column1: (The giant dragon let out a long and low neigh, lowered its body, spread its wings, and dove towards the sea of sand below.)
column2: (Naga raksasa itu mengeluarkan ringkikan panjang dan rendah, merendahkan tubuhnya, membentangkan sayapnya, lalu menukik ke lautan pasir di bawah.)
（"Wuuush——"）

column1: (The fierce wind tore at her ears. Ateraxis's fingertips brushed across the crystal scales on the giant dragon's body, found a protrusion, and gently held it.)
column2: (Angin ganas menyayat telinganya. Ujung jari Ateraxis menyusuri sisik kristal di tubuh naga itu, menemukan tonjolan, lalu menggenggamnya lembut.)

column1: (Accompanied by the feeling of weightlessness from the rapid fall, a low rumbling sound came from deep within Graurizard's body.)
column2: (Diiringi rasa melayang akibat terjun cepat, gemuruh rendah terdengar dari dalam tubuh Graurizard.)

column1: (However, Ateraxis simply lowered her body nonchalantly, maintaining balance with one arm, while slightly extending the other, as if gently stroking the wind blowing past her ears.)
column2: (Namun Ateraxis begitu saja merendahkan tubuhnya dengan santai, menjaga keseimbangan dengan satu lengan, sementara lengan lainnya sedikit terulur, seolah mengusap lembut angin yang berembus melewati telinganya.)

column1: Ready...
column2: Bersiap...

column1: (As the Elmo gradually took up more space in her field of vision, the purring deep in Graurizard's throat became increasingly frequent.)
column2: (Seiring Elmo makin memenuhi pandangannya, dengkuran jauh di kerongkongan Graurizard makin sering terdengar.)

column1: (For anyone, this is an extremely dangerous signal.)
column2: (Bagi siapa pun, itu isyarat yang teramat berbahaya.)

column1: (Lethal green liquid bombs are rapidly brewing in some kind of structure called 'glands' within it.)
column2: (Bom cair hijau yang mematikan sedang diracik cepat di dalam semacam struktur bernama 'kelenjar' dalam tubuhnya.)

column1: (In the battle at Mokosh just now, Graurizard had consumed most of her threatening bodily fluid bombs. After being heavily injured by that special power again, she should have needed time to rest and recover.)
column2: (Dalam pertempuran di Mokosh tadi, Graurizard sudah menghabiskan sebagian besar bom cairan tubuhnya yang mengancam. Setelah kembali terluka parah oleh kekuatan khusus itu, dia semestinya butuh waktu untuk beristirahat dan pulih.)

column1: (But now is not the time.)
column2: (Tapi sekarang bukan saatnya.)

column1: (Fortunately, as her "sister", Ateraxis could share some of her power with her, allowing her to maintain basic combat capabilities.)
column2: (Untungnya, sebagai "saudari"-nya, Ateraxis bisa membagi sebagian kekuatannya, sehingga naga itu tetap punya kemampuan tempur dasar.)

column1: (And now, once The Elmo enters absolute range, the venom in Graurizard's glands is just enough to melt its outer armor like plastic, turning it into a twisted scorched earth along with anything around it.)
column2: (Dan sekarang, begitu Elmo masuk ke jangkauan mutlak, bisa di kelenjar Graurizard cukup untuk melelehkan lapis baja luarnya seperti plastik, mengubahnya jadi tanah hangus yang melintir bersama segala yang ada di sekitarnya.)

column1: (But to save Graurizard's strength, she doesn't plan to do this for now.)
column2: (Tapi demi menghemat tenaga Graurizard, untuk sekarang dia tidak berniat melakukannya.)

column1: (She only hopes that the Commander can assess the situation and actively stop the base vehicle, allowing her to pay a polite visit.)
column2: (Dia hanya berharap Komandan bisa membaca keadaan dan dengan sukarela menghentikan kendaraan markas itu, sehingga dia bisa bertamu dengan sopan.)

column1: (After all, the more hostile they are, the more favorable impression she has of that person, and Mother seems to be the same—although he is not a saintly role model, he is an ideal embodiment representing humanity's will to struggle.)
column2: (Lagi pula, makin memusuhi mereka, makin baik kesannya terhadap orang itu, dan Ibu sepertinya juga begitu—meski dia bukan teladan suci, dia adalah perwujudan ideal yang mewakili kehendak umat manusia untuk berjuang.)

column1: (After several rounds of pursuit, The Elmo was not forced to stop as she had imagined, but instead made several sharp turns in succession, trying to find a way to shake off the giant dragon.)
column2: (Setelah beberapa ronde pengejaran, Elmo tidak terpaksa berhenti seperti yang dia bayangkan, melainkan berbelok tajam berkali-kali, mencari cara melepaskan diri dari naga raksasa itu.)

column1: It seems you don't intend to cooperate... Commander.
column2: Sepertinya kau tidak berniat bekerja sama... Komandan.

column1: Then...
column2: Kalau begitu...

column1: (Three thousand meters... two thousand meters...)
column2: (Tiga ribu meter... dua ribu meter...)

column1: (One thousand meters.)
column2: (Seribu meter.)

column1: (Ateraxis gave a thumbs up, aiming at the increasingly large target in her field of vision with half-closed eyes in mid-air.)
column2: (Ateraxis mengacungkan ibu jari, membidik sasaran yang makin membesar di pandangannya dengan mata setengah terpejam di udara.)

column1: (The wind passed through her arms, like an arrow nocked on a bowstring. At the same time, Graurizard also arched its back—)
column2: (Angin melewati lengannya, bagai anak panah yang terpasang di tali busur. Di saat yang sama, Graurizard juga melengkungkan punggungnya—)

column1: ("Whoosh—" "Bang!")
column2: ("Wuush—" "Blam!")

column1: (Just as Ateraxis was about to order Graurizard to start the battle, a blinding light suddenly rose from the top deck of The Elmo.)
column2: (Tepat saat Ateraxis hendak memerintahkan Graurizard memulai pertempuran, cahaya menyilaukan tiba-tiba membubung dari geladak atas Elmo.)

column1: (A steel meteor trailing jet exhaust tore through the air above the sea of sand, and at an almost jaw-dropping angle, flew up against the trajectory of the giant dragon's dive.)
column2: (Sebuah meteor baja yang menyeret semburan jet merobek udara di atas lautan pasir, dan dengan sudut yang nyaris membuat ternganga, melesat naik melawan lintasan tukikan naga raksasa itu.)

column1: (But faster than that is a volley of weapon shells fired from its body.)
column2: (Tapi yang lebih cepat dari itu adalah rentetan peluru yang ditembakkan dari tubuhnya.)

column1: ("Boom, boom, boom—")
column2: ("Buum, buum, buum—")

column1: (The artillery fire accurately closed in on the trajectory the dragon had to pass through moments later, forcing her to immediately change direction.)
column2: (Tembakan artileri itu tepat mengunci lintasan yang sesaat lagi harus dilewati sang naga, memaksanya langsung berbelok arah.)

column1: In the way...
column2: Menghalangi...

column1: (Ateraxis's gaze caught that 'shooting star'.)
column2: (Pandangan Ateraxis menangkap 'bintang jatuh' itu.)

column1: So it's you...
column2: Ternyata kau...

column1: (She had seen it in some interesting materials—that mech named "Sinbreaker".)
column2: (Dia pernah melihatnya di beberapa bahan bacaan yang menarik—mech bernama "Sinbreaker" itu.)

column1: (And the one piloting it was just an ordinary... "second-generation Doll" who could even be called single-threaded compared to herself.)
column2: (Dan yang mengemudikannya cuma seorang... "Doll generasi kedua" biasa yang dibanding dirinya bahkan bisa disebut berpikir satu jalur.)

column1: You did indeed use it to defeat a certain... sister of mine.
column2: Kau memang pernah memakainya untuk mengalahkan salah satu... saudariku.

column1: But this trick is completely useless against me.
column2: Tapi trik itu sama sekali tidak mempan padaku.

column1: However, since this is your duty...
column2: Tapi karena ini memang tugasmu...

column1: Then I will satisfy the hero's obsession with going to their death.
column2: Maka akan kupuaskan obsesi sang pahlawan untuk menyongsong kematiannya.

column1: (Ateraxis's gaze shifted away from The Elmo on the ground for a moment, locking onto the Sinbreaker rushing towards her.)
column2: (Pandangan Ateraxis sesaat beralih dari Elmo di darat, mengunci Sinbreaker yang menerjang ke arahnya.)

column1: （“哒哒哒哒——”）
column2: （"Tak tak tak tak——"）

column1: (A row of assault rifle bullets accurately swept towards the giant dragon's jaw.)
column2: (Sederet peluru senapan serbu tepat menyapu ke arah rahang naga raksasa itu.)

column1: (Under the dense firepower suppression, Graurizard's throat let out a displeased low growl—)
column2: (Di bawah tekanan tembakan yang rapat itu, kerongkongan Graurizard mengeluarkan geraman rendah tanda tak suka—)

column1: Graurizard, over here!
column2: Graurizard, ke sini!

column1: (Ateraxis gently patted the giant dragon's side neck. Graurizard's massive body suddenly spun in the air, turning back at a thrilling angle, completely abandoning its dive towards the ground target, and instead flapped its wings to face the Sinbreaker in front of it.)
column2: (Ateraxis menepuk pelan sisi leher naga raksasa itu. Tubuh masif Graurizard mendadak berputar di udara, berbalik dengan sudut yang mendebarkan, sepenuhnya meninggalkan tukikannya ke sasaran darat, dan justru mengepakkan sayap menghadapi Sinbreaker di depannya.)

column1: Your opponent is me.
column2: Lawanmu adalah aku.

column1: As you wish.
column2: Sesuai keinginanmu.

column1: (The airflow from the thrusters and the wing wind of the giant dragon entangled together, pushing the battlefield all the way to a higher place.)
column2: (Aliran udara dari pendorong dan angin sayap naga raksasa itu saling berjalin, mendorong medan tempur mereka naik ke tempat yang lebih tinggi.)

column1: (The roar of the air being torn apart resounded through the sky—here, it was a battlefield belonging only to them, where no one could come to disturb.)
column2: (Deru udara yang tercabik menggema di langit—di sini, ini medan tempur milik mereka berdua saja, tempat tak seorang pun bisa datang mengganggu.)

column1: (Rat-tat-tat-tat—)
column2: (Tak-tak-tak-tak—)

column1: (Without any superfluous probing, Voymastina was the first to pull the trigger. The wall-mounted assault rifle on the mech let out a crisp roar, and a dense hail of bullets poured out one after another towards the direction where the giant dragon was.)
column2: (Tanpa penjajakan berlebih, Voymastina yang pertama menarik pelatuk. Senapan serbu yang terpasang di badan mech itu meraung nyaring, dan hujan peluru yang rapat mengucur bertubi-tubi ke arah naga raksasa itu.)

column1: (At the same time—)
column2: (Di saat yang sama—)

column1: ("Pew—" "Pew—")
column2: ("Syuut—" "Syuut—")

column1: (Two grenades whistled out trailing smoke, blocking the giant dragon's retreat on both wings.)
column2: (Dua granat melesat bersiul menyeret asap, menutup jalur mundur naga raksasa itu di kedua sayapnya.)

column1: You're being underestimated, Graurizard.
column2: Kau sedang diremehkan, Graurizard.

column1: (Ateraxis expressionlessly patted the giant dragon's scales.)
column2: (Tanpa ekspresi Ateraxis menepuk sisik naga raksasa itu.)

column1: (Graurizard's huge fleshy wings flapped violently, and its massive body actually displayed an agility extremely inconsistent with its size, turning sideways like a fighter jet to avoid the trajectory of the howitzer.)
column2: (Sayap daging raksasa Graurizard mengepak hebat, dan tubuh masifnya justru menunjukkan kelincahan yang sama sekali tak sepadan dengan ukurannya, memiring bagai jet tempur untuk menghindari lintasan howitzer itu.)

column1: (At the same time, it opened its jaws, and clusters of viscous liquid bombs were spat out one after another, smashing towards the Sinbreaker mech like meteorites.)
column2: (Di saat bersamaan, dia membuka rahangnya, dan gumpalan bom cair yang kental disemburkan bertubi-tubi, menghantam mech Sinbreaker bagai meteor.)

column1: (The liquid bombs detonated one after another in mid-air, and the violent explosions set off scorching waves of air.)
column2: (Bom-bom cair itu meledak beruntun di udara, dan ledakan dahsyatnya menimbulkan gelombang udara yang membakar.)

column1: Sinbreaker, activate manual control mode!
column2: Sinbreaker, aktifkan mode kendali manual!

column1: (The moment the somatic link disconnected, Voymastina pushed the control stick all the way down—after several consecutive barrel rolls, she finally barely dodged the core blast radius of the liquid bomb explosion.)
column2: (Begitu tautan somatiknya terputus, Voymastina mendorong tuas kendali sampai mentok—setelah beberapa kali berguling di udara berturut-turut, dia akhirnya nyaris saja lolos dari radius inti ledakan bom cair itu.)

column1: ...Interesting.
column2: ...Menarik.

column1: (Ateraxis looked with interest at the Sinbreaker that had clumsily rolled 1080° in the air, a curious smile appearing on her face.)
column2: (Ateraxis menatap dengan tertarik Sinbreaker yang berguling 1080° dengan kikuk di udara, senyum penasaran muncul di wajahnya.)

column1: (In an instant, her consciousness replaced Graurizard. Ateraxis, who understood how to utilize wings and air currents better than the dragon, made a sharp turn in the air—)
column2: (Seketika, kesadarannya menggantikan Graurizard. Ateraxis, yang lebih paham cara memanfaatkan sayap dan arus udara daripada sang naga, berbelok tajam di udara—)

column1: ...What!
column2: ...Apa!

column1: (The giant dragon's tail fin suddenly flicked, and Voymastina's mech fell from mid-air in response.)
column2: (Sirip ekor naga raksasa itu tiba-tiba menyentak, dan mech Voymastina pun langsung jatuh dari udara.)

column1: ('Whoosh—')
column2: ('Wuush—')

column1: ('Beep beep beep beep beep beep beep beep—')
column2: ('Bip bip bip bip bip bip bip bip—')

column1: (We absolutely cannot continue to drag this out—Voymastina made this judgment immediately.)
column2: (Kita sama sekali tidak boleh membiarkan ini berlarut-larut—Voymastina langsung mengambil kesimpulan itu.)

column1: (Even though the Sinbreaker has extremely high aerial mobility and is more agile than the giant dragon, the opponent is like an aerial fortress with infinite ammunition and extremely high defense.)
column2: (Meski Sinbreaker punya kelincahan udara yang sangat tinggi dan lebih gesit daripada naga raksasa itu, lawannya bagai benteng udara dengan amunisi tak terbatas dan pertahanan yang sangat tinggi.)

column1: (Relying solely on the firepower of Sinbreaker and the underbarrel assault rifle was not enough for her to break the deadlock.)
column2: (Hanya mengandalkan daya tembak Sinbreaker dan senapan serbu di bawah laras tidak cukup baginya untuk memecah kebuntuan.)

column1: (To completely resolve the current predicament, there is only one way...)
column2: (Untuk benar-benar menyelesaikan kesulitan saat ini, hanya ada satu cara...)

column1: (Close the distance and attack the rider on the dragon's back directly.)
column2: (Memperpendek jarak dan langsung menyerang penunggang di punggung naga itu.)

column1: (At the same time as confirming the plan, Voymastina had already begun to move.)
column2: (Bersamaan dengan memastikan rencananya, Voymastina sudah mulai bergerak.)

column1: Sinbreaker weapon mount released!
column2: Dudukan senjata Sinbreaker dilepas!

column1: ('Click—')
column2: ('Klik—')

column1: (Voymastina pressed the disarm button.)
column2: (Voymastina menekan tombol pelepas senjata.)

column1: (The Sinbreaker unreservedly poured out its remaining grenade inventory. Over a dozen howitzers exploded in the air, forming a small, tight net of fire—this time, she wasn't aiming at the dragon, but the airspace in front of them.)
column2: (Sinbreaker menumpahkan seluruh sisa persediaan granatnya tanpa sisa. Lebih dari selusin howitzer meledak di udara, membentuk jaring api kecil yang rapat—kali ini dia tidak membidik sang naga, melainkan ruang udara di depan mereka.)

column1: (Chain explosions blasted clusters of thick, turbid black smoke in mid-air. Using the cover of the smoke screen, Voymastina pushed the thruster joystick all the way to the end—)
column2: (Ledakan beruntun itu memuntahkan gumpalan asap hitam pekat di udara. Memakai tabir asap itu sebagai penyamaran, Voymastina mendorong tuas pendorongnya sampai mentok—)

column1: (Accompanied by a loud bang, the thruster tail flame behind the mech instantly turned from blue to dazzling white light.)
column2: (Diiringi ledakan keras, lidah api pendorong di belakang mech itu seketika berubah dari biru menjadi cahaya putih yang menyilaukan.)

column1: (Sinbreaker penetrated the smoke like an arrow, diving at full speed towards Ateraxis's position.)
column2: (Sinbreaker menembus asap bagai anak panah, menukik dengan kecepatan penuh ke posisi Ateraxis.)

column1: (However, the moment she rushed out of the smoke screen, an incredible thing happened.)
column2: (Namun tepat saat dia menerjang keluar dari tabir asap, hal yang tak terbayangkan terjadi.)

column1: ...How is that possible...!
column2: ...Mana mungkin...!

column1: (Ateraxis held the reins with one hand, and using the power of the iron chain, she rode the airflow into the air, arriving in front of Voymastina in an instant.)
column2: (Ateraxis memegang tali kekang dengan satu tangan, dan memakai tenaga rantai besi itu, dia menunggangi arus udara ke atas, tiba di depan Voymastina dalam sekejap.)

column1: (Because the distance was close enough, Voymastina could even see some unnatural wriggling starting on the surface of Ateraxis's arm—)
column2: (Karena jaraknya cukup dekat, Voymastina bahkan bisa melihat geliat tak wajar mulai muncul di permukaan lengan Ateraxis—)

column1: (The pale tissue boils up like hot water, then rapidly hardens and extends.)
column2: (Jaringan pucat itu mendidih bagai air panas, lalu cepat mengeras dan memanjang.)

column1: (In the blink of an eye, a white spear appears out of thin air in Ateraxis's hand.)
column2: (Dalam sekejap mata, sebatang tombak putih muncul entah dari mana di tangan Ateraxis.)

column1: (As the spear thrown by Ateraxis approaches, the Sinbreaker's alarm system instantly spikes into the red.)
column2: (Saat tombak lemparan Ateraxis mendekat, sistem sirene Sinbreaker seketika melonjak ke merah.)

column1: (*Clang*—!)
column2: (*Trang*—!)

column1: (The piercing sound of tearing metal resounded through the air.)
column2: (Bunyi logam tercabik yang memekakkan menggema di udara.)

column1: (The spear in Ateraxis's hand accurately and brutally pierced through Sinbreaker's left arm armor, forcefully forcing it to stop in mid-air.)
column2: (Tombak di tangan Ateraxis dengan tepat dan brutal menembus pelindung lengan kiri Sinbreaker, memaksanya berhenti paksa di udara.)

column1: (In the next instant, sparks mixed with the mech's coolant splashed in the air, and the mech's alarm sound was deafening.)
column2: (Sesaat kemudian, percikan api bercampur pendingin mech itu berhamburan di udara, dan sirene mech-nya memekakkan telinga.)

column1: ...Voymastina, right?
column2: ...Voymastina, ya?

column1: I will remember your name.
column2: Akan kuingat namamu.

column1: (Using the reaction force from the giant dragon's fierce wing flaps, Ateraxis swung her spear with one hand, drawing a huge arc in the air—and threw Sinbreaker entirely out!)
column2: (Memakai daya balik dari kepakan sayap ganas naga raksasa itu, Ateraxis mengayunkan tombaknya dengan satu tangan, menggores lengkungan besar di udara—lalu melempar Sinbreaker sepenuhnya keluar!)

column1: (Voymastina could feel that the weapon system connected to her left arm was offline, and she herself was spinning with extremely high centrifugal force like a cell in a centrifuge!)
column2: (Voymastina bisa merasakan sistem senjata yang terhubung ke lengan kirinya sudah mati, dan dirinya sendiri berputar dengan gaya sentrifugal yang sangat tinggi bagai sel di dalam mesin pemusing!)

column1: (Under Ateraxis's overwhelming combat power, she was already out of options.)
column2: (Di bawah daya tempur Ateraxis yang menggilas, dia sudah kehabisan pilihan.)

column1: (*Bang!*)
column2: (*Blam!*)

column1: (Voymastina pressed the detonation button, and the mech's left arm, firmly pinned by the spear, was blown off along with the damaged combat parts. The mech fell off in response, leaving a severed arm smoking black smoke on Ateraxis's spear.)
column2: (Voymastina menekan tombol detonasi, dan lengan kiri mech yang tertancap erat tombak itu meledak lepas bersama bagian tempur yang rusak. Mech itu langsung terlepas, menyisakan sepotong lengan yang mengepulkan asap hitam di tombak Ateraxis.)

column1: (She certainly understood what consequences choosing to separate the mech at an altitude of thousands of meters would cause.)
column2: (Dia tentu paham akibat apa yang ditimbulkan kalau memilih melepas mech di ketinggian ribuan meter.)

column1: (But she can't afford to worry about that now.)
column2: (Tapi sekarang dia tak sempat memikirkan itu.)

column1: (The moment she loses the counterweight of her left arm, the Sinbreaker's body jerks violently to one side—)
column2: (Begitu kehilangan penyeimbang lengan kirinya, badan Sinbreaker tersentak hebat ke satu sisi—)

column1: ("Hiss—")
column2: ("Sshh—")

column1: (The armor of Sinbreaker's remaining right arm split open to both sides, and a piece of metal gleaming with cold light quietly poked out.)
column2: (Pelindung lengan kanan Sinbreaker yang tersisa terbelah ke dua sisi, dan sebilah logam yang berkilau dingin menyembul diam-diam.)

column1: (The dilapidated mech was like a lone wolf breaking free from its shackles, completely abandoning all defense.)
column2: (Mech yang sudah rombeng itu bagai serigala tunggal yang lepas dari belenggunya, sepenuhnya meninggalkan segala pertahanan.)

column1: This is loyalty dedicated to the Commander, right? I really hope the third-generation Doll sisters can learn from it.
column2: Ini kesetiaan yang dipersembahkan untuk Komandan, kan? Aku benar-benar berharap para saudari Doll generasi ketiga bisa belajar dari ini.

column1: (The hand spike stopped one centimeter in front of Ateraxis's face. Ateraxis's eyes carried confusion. She tilted her head, as if watching a beetle waving its pincers at her.)
column2: (Duri tangan itu berhenti satu sentimeter di depan wajah Ateraxis. Mata Ateraxis menyiratkan kebingungan. Dia memiringkan kepala, seolah menonton seekor kumbang mengayunkan capitnya padanya.)

column1: (And at this time, Voymastina had already tried her best, but could not advance any further no matter what.)
column2: (Dan saat itu, Voymastina sudah berusaha sekuat tenaga, tapi bagaimanapun tak bisa maju lebih jauh lagi.)

column1: (Crack—)
column2: (Retak—)

column1: (Starting from the point where all the power of the hand spike gathered, a crack suddenly appeared in the originally transparent air.)
column2: (Bermula dari titik tempat seluruh tenaga duri tangan itu terhimpun, sebuah retakan tiba-tiba muncul di udara yang semula bening.)

column1: (The crack that spread like a spider weaving a web suddenly shattered, but also neutralized Voymastina's last bit of strength.)
column2: (Retakan yang menjalar bagai laba-laba menganyam jaring itu tiba-tiba pecah, tapi sekaligus menetralkan sisa tenaga terakhir Voymastina.)

column1: Is this all that can be done...
column2: Cuma sebatas ini yang bisa dilakukan...

column1: It's enough...
column2: Sudah cukup...

column1: (Ateraxis opened her hand, and those shattered transparent crystals turned into a giant bone scythe, forming out of thin air in her palm.)
column2: (Ateraxis membuka tangannya, dan pecahan kristal bening itu berubah menjadi sabit tulang raksasa, terbentuk entah dari mana di telapak tangannya.)

column1: (A dull sound of metal shattering suddenly resounded through the sky.)
column2: (Bunyi logam pecah yang tumpul tiba-tiba menggema di langit.)

column1: (The violent impact was transmitted through the mech to Voymastina's heavy Frame—)
column2: (Hantaman dahsyat itu merambat lewat mech sampai ke Frame berat Voymastina—)

column1: (The Wolf Eye system failed. She felt a blur in front of her.)
column2: (Sistem Wolf Eye lumpuh. Pandangannya mengabur.)

column1: (The mech's power system was completely paralyzed. Ateraxis stood on the dragon's back, looking down at the Doll in front of her with cold eyes...)
column2: (Sistem tenaga mech itu lumpuh total. Ateraxis berdiri di punggung naga, menatap turun ke arah Doll di depannya dengan mata yang dingin...)

column1: (She tried to see despair and fear in Voymastina's eyes, but there was none.)
column2: (Dia mencoba menemukan keputusasaan dan ketakutan di mata Voymastina, tapi tidak ada.)

column1: (On that usually serious face, a subtle smile actually appeared.)
column2: (Di wajah yang biasanya serius itu justru muncul senyum tipis.)

column1: ("Click—")
column2: ("Klik—")

column1: (For the scene in front of them, it was nothing but an insignificant soft sound.)
column2: (Bagi pemandangan di depan mereka, itu tak lebih dari bunyi pelan yang tak berarti.)

column1: (But Ateraxis immediately understood what it meant.)
column2: (Tapi Ateraxis langsung memahami artinya.)

column1: (The mech's alarms and vibrations replaced the pilot's roar. Using the rotational inertia of the mech detaching, Voymastina turned the remaining thruster power to the maximum.)
column2: (Sirene dan getaran mech itu menggantikan raungan pengemudinya. Memakai inersia putar dari lepasnya mech, Voymastina memutar sisa daya pendorongnya ke maksimal.)

column1: (Thousands of meters in the sky, Voymastina's frame detached from the mech, plunging straight down toward the ground.)
column2: (Ribuan meter di langit, frame Voymastina terlepas dari mech itu, terjun lurus ke arah tanah.)

column1: (Meanwhile, the Sinbreaker was propelled toward the dragon's body by a fierce reaction force!)
column2: (Sementara itu, Sinbreaker terdorong ke tubuh sang naga oleh daya balik yang dahsyat!)

column1: (The final scene in Voymastina's eyes was the burning wreckage of the Sinbreaker exploding in midair along with the dragon.)
column2: (Pemandangan terakhir di mata Voymastina adalah bangkai Sinbreaker yang terbakar meledak di udara bersama sang naga.)

column1: (My mission... has been completed.)
column2: (Misiku... sudah tuntas.)

column1: (Next, I just have to believe in my partners and believe in the Commander. That's all there is to it.)
column2: (Selanjutnya, aku tinggal memercayai rekan-rekanku dan memercayai Komandan. Cuma itu saja.)
